# FundAdmin AI

> 62 fund administration skills for Claude Code, Cowork and Codex: review LPAs, PPMs, side letters, capital calls, distributions, K-1s and capital account statements; draft notices and investor letters; run compliance, KYC/AML and FATCA/CRS checks; track obligations and MFN elections; model performance and cash flows; and produce PDF reports. Installs as the `fundadmin` plugin; no server or API key. Not financial, legal or tax advice.

## Docs

- [Manual](https://help.fundadmin.dev): user manual: install, quick start, every command, the agents, output files
- [README](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, how it works, every command
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents installing, using or changing the plugin
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable index of skills and agents
- [Samples](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/samples/README.md): synthetic documents with planted issues

## Skills

- [fund](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund/SKILL.md): Menu and router for the 62 FundAdmin AI skills. Use when the user runs `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund`, asks what the fund admin assistant can do, or wants a fund task without naming a skill.
- [fund-review-lpa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-lpa/SKILL.md): Flagship LPA review: five agents (terms, risks, compliance, obligations, recommendations) scored into an LPA Safety Score. Use for `/fund review-lpa` or an LPA. Writes `LPA-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-ppm](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-ppm/SKILL.md): Scores a PPM or offering memo on risk factors, fee disclosure, regulatory status (Reg D, 3(c)(1)/(7), ERISA) and LPA fit. Use for `/fund review-ppm` or a PPM. Writes `PPM-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-subscription](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-subscription/SKILL.md): Checks a subscription agreement: qualification, FATCA/CRS forms, AML and ERISA reps, signatures; scores it. Use for `/fund review-subscription`. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-side-letter/SKILL.md): Inventories a side letter's rights and obligations, rates MFN cascade risk, flags LPA and side-letter conflicts. Use for `/fund review-side-letter`. Writes `SIDE-LETTER-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-call/SKILL.md): Validates a capital call notice: pro-rata math, fees, wire instructions, due dates, LPA fit; scores 1-10. Use for `/fund review-capital-call`. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-distribution-notice](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-distribution-notice/SKILL.md): Validates a distribution notice: tax credits, RWT, return of capital vs income. Use for `/fund review-distribution-notice` or a distribution notice. Writes DISTRIBUTION-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-capital-account](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-capital-account/SKILL.md): Validates a capital account statement to the dollar: every field, ending capital math, tranches. Use for `/fund review-capital-account` or a statement. Writes CAPITAL-ACCOUNT-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-k1](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-k1/SKILL.md): Reviews a Schedule K-1 (Form 1065): every box and Section L, capital account math, UBTI/ECI flags, completeness. Use for `/fund review-k1` or a K-1. Writes `K1-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-poa](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-poa/SKILL.md): Reviews a power of attorney: grantor, attorneys, authority clauses, breadth of discretion, cross-border gaps. Use for `/fund review-poa` or a POA or mandate. Writes `POA-REVIEW-[date].md`.
- [fund-review-gp-update](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-gp-update/SKILL.md): Analyzes a GP update: FPAUM bridge, deployment, realisations, fundraising, MOIC vs plan; scores 1-10. Use for `/fund review-gp-update` or a GP letter. Writes GP-UPDATE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-compare](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-compare/SKILL.md): Compares two fund documents, rating each difference material to cosmetic and who it favors. Use for `/fund compare` or what changed between versions. Writes FUND-COMPARISON-[name]-[date].md.
- [fund-extract-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-extract-terms/SKILL.md): Extracts defined terms, fees, key dates, governance and reporting duties with plain-English notes and section refs. Use for `/fund extract-terms`. Writes TERMS-EXTRACT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-capital-call](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-capital-call/SKILL.md): Drafts an ILPA capital call notice: purpose, per-LP pro-rata table, default terms, wire instructions. Use for `/fund draft-capital-call`. Writes CAPITAL-CALL-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-distribution](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-distribution/SKILL.md): Drafts a distribution notice: waterfall tier math, per-LP split, withholding, clawback reserve. Use for `/fund draft-distribution`. Writes DISTRIBUTION-NOTICE-[fund]-[number]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-investor-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-investor-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts LP letters: quarterly update, meeting notice, welcome, closing, extension, wind-down. Use for `/fund draft-investor-letter <type>`. Writes INVESTOR-LETTER-[fund]-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-draft-side-letter](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-draft-side-letter/SKILL.md): Drafts an LP side letter from requested terms (fee discount, MFN, co-invest, ERISA) with LPA references. Use for `/fund draft-side-letter`. Writes SIDE-LETTER-[investor]-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-check-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-check-compliance/SKILL.md): Scores a fund document against FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC, ERISA, Form PF/D/ADV, AIFMD, SFDR and the Marketing Rule. Use for `/fund check-compliance`. Writes COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-review/SKILL.md): Scores one investor's KYC/AML package out of 100 (identity, UBOs, sanctions, PEP, source of funds) and rates risk. Use for `/fund kyc-review` or a KYC package. Writes KYC-REVIEW-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-filing](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-filing/SKILL.md): Preps a Form PF, D, ADV, 13F, FATCA/CRS or FBAR package: data points, completeness score, gaps. Use for `/fund regulatory-filing` or filing prep. Writes FILING-PREP-[type]-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-audit-support](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-audit-support/SKILL.md): Audit package from capital account data: auditor confirmation letter, partner capital and fee schedules. Use for `/fund audit-support` or annual audit prep. Writes AUDIT-SUPPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-waterfall-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-waterfall-review/SKILL.md): Extracts waterfall tiers, pref, catch-up, carry, clawback and fees, checks consistency, scores vs market. Use for `/fund waterfall-review`. Writes `WATERFALL-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-report-pdf](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-report-pdf/SKILL.md): Renders the latest fund review as a branded PDF with score gauge, risk dashboard and priorities; needs Python and ReportLab. Use for `/fund report-pdf`. Writes FUND-REVIEW-REPORT.pdf.
- [fund-lpa-negotiate](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-lpa-negotiate/SKILL.md): Turns LP-unfavorable LPA terms into counter-language ranked P0-P4, with a negotiation roadmap and concessions. Use for `/fund lpa-negotiate`. Writes NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-benchmark](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-benchmark/SKILL.md): Scores economic and governance terms against reference ranges, LP-Friendly to GP-Favorable, 0-100. Use for `/fund benchmark` or market checks. Writes BENCHMARK-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-plain-english](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-plain-english/SKILL.md): Translates a fund document clause by clause into plain English: impact, risk flags, glossary, worked examples. Use for `/fund plain-english`. Writes PLAIN-ENGLISH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-playbook](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-playbook/SKILL.md): Tracks how a GP's LPA terms drift across vintages and builds a playbook of positions and red lines. Use for `/fund playbook` or LPAs from several vintages. Writes TERMS-PLAYBOOK-[date].md.
- [fund-search-precedent](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-search-precedent/SKILL.md): Searches prior reviews for matching provisions, ranked by fund, vintage and section, flagging outliers. Use for `/fund search-precedent`. Writes PRECEDENT-SEARCH-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-counsel-handoff](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-counsel-handoff/SKILL.md): Packages an LPA, PPM or side letter review into a counsel brief: P0-P3 triage, redlines, open questions. Use for `/fund counsel-handoff`. Writes COUNSEL-HANDOFF-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-mfn-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-mfn-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks MFN rights across a fund's side letters: per-LP eligibility, cascade risk, election forms, disclosures. Use for `/fund mfn-tracker`. Writes MFN-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-obligation-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-obligation-tracker/SKILL.md): Inventories side letter obligations by type, frequency, due date and status, with an exam-ready log. Use for `/fund obligation-tracker`. Writes OBLIGATION-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-covenant-monitor](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-covenant-monitor/SKILL.md): Extracts financial, reporting and negative covenants from a credit facility; reports compliance and headroom. Use for `/fund covenant-monitor`. Writes COVENANT-MONITOR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-regulatory-calendar](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-calendar/SKILL.md): 12-month filing calendar (Form ADV, PF, D, FATCA/CRS, AIFMD Annex IV) with 90/60/30-day alerts. Use for `/fund regulatory-calendar` or upcoming filings. Writes REGULATORY-CALENDAR-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-performance-calc](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-performance-calc/SKILL.md): Computes IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, MOIC and PME from cash flows or statements, with workpapers and J-curve. Use for `/fund performance-calc` or fund returns. Writes PERFORMANCE-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-cashflow-forecast](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-cashflow-forecast/SKILL.md): Projects quarterly calls, distributions and NAV (Takahashi-Alexander) with J-curve and sensitivities. Use for `/fund cashflow-forecast` or LP liquidity. Writes CASHFLOW-FORECAST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-scenario-model](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-scenario-model/SKILL.md): Models downside, base and upside cases: IRR, TVPI, DPI, carry, LP net returns, waterfall tier, breakeven. Use for `/fund scenario-model` or stress tests. Writes `SCENARIO-MODEL-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-fee-audit](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fee-audit/SKILL.md): Audits management fees, offsets, expense caps, pref, catch-up, carry and clawback against the LPA and ILPA template. Use for `/fund fee-audit` or checking fees. Writes FEE-AUDIT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-onboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-onboard/SKILL.md): Onboarding checklist by investor type: documents, accreditation and QP tests, AML/KYC, timeline. Use for `/fund investor-onboard` or a new investor. Writes ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-ddq-respond](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ddq-respond/SKILL.md): Drafts DDQ or RFP answers mapped to ILPA sections, citing sources, grading A-F, flagging items needing a human. Use for `/fund ddq-respond` or a DDQ. Writes DDQ-RESPONSE-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-entity-map](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-entity-map/SKILL.md): Maps a fund structure: Mermaid diagram, entity registry, ownership and fee flows, blocker and ERISA gaps. Use for `/fund entity-map` or formation documents. Writes ENTITY-MAP-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-data-room](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-data-room/SKILL.md): ILPA-aligned data room index: eight categories, Required/Recommended/Optional status, gaps, access tiers. Use for `/fund data-room <type>` or fundraising. Writes DATA-ROOM-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-portfolio-dashboard](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-portfolio-dashboard/SKILL.md): Rolls several funds into one LP view: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, strategy and GP mix, J-curve stage, unfunded. Use for `/fund portfolio-dashboard` or book-level status. Writes PORTFOLIO-DASHBOARD-[date].md.
- [fund-reconcile](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-reconcile/SKILL.md): Reconciles two fund documents line by line: call vs statement, distribution vs K-1, or two statements. Use for `/fund reconcile` or balances that don't tie. Writes RECONCILIATION-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-review-deed](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-review-deed/SKILL.md): Reviews a deed of adherence, equity wrapper or MIP agreement: obligations, vesting, leaver terms, access limits. Use for `/fund review-deed` or leaver terms. Writes DEED-REVIEW-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-investor-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-investor-classify/SKILL.md): Classifies an investor's regulatory category, builds its document checklist, maps FATCA, CRS, ERISA, UBTI, ECI. Use for `/fund investor-classify`. Writes INVESTOR-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-fatca-crs-classify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-fatca-crs-classify/SKILL.md): Determines an investor's FATCA ch. 3/4 status, FFI/NFFE type, CRS class, forms, controlling persons. Use for `/fund fatca-crs-classify`. Writes FATCA-CRS-CLASSIFICATION-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-suitability-check](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-suitability-check/SKILL.md): Verifies Accredited Investor, Qualified Purchaser and Qualified Client status, flagging borderline cases. Use for `/fund suitability-check`. Writes `SUITABILITY-CHECK-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-aml-screen](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-aml-screen/SKILL.md): AML/CFT screen of an investor: ID, 25% UBOs, PEP, OFAC/UN sanctions, source of funds, adverse media, risk. Use for `/fund aml-screen`. Writes AML-SCREENING-[investor]-[date].md.
- [fund-kyc-tracker](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-tracker/SKILL.md): Tracks KYC across a fund's investors: completeness, missing documents, expiry alerts, refresh cycles. Use for `/fund kyc-tracker` or fund-wide KYC status. Writes KYC-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-subscription-process](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-subscription-process/SKILL.md): End-to-end investor onboarding: classify, documents, suitability, FATCA/CRS, AML, subscription, verdict. Use for `/fund subscription-process`. Writes `SUBSCRIPTION-PROCESS-[investor]-[date].md`.
- [fund-ingest](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest/SKILL.md): Classifies a folder of fund PDFs, routes each to its review skill, reconciles pairs, adds a dashboard at 3+ funds. Use for `/fund ingest`. Writes INGEST-REPORT-[date].md and INGEST-MANIFEST.md.
- [fund-ingest-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-ingest-email/SKILL.md): Parses a GP email and attachments, checking stated amounts, dates and funds against the documents for mismatches and wire fraud. Use for `/fund ingest-email`. Writes EMAIL-INGEST-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-vault-init](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-init/SKILL.md): Creates an Obsidian vault for fund administration: review folders, Dataview dashboards, Fund and Investor templates and an Inbox. Use for `/fund vault-init` or setting up a fund knowledge base.
- [fund-vault-sync](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-sync/SKILL.md): Syncs review outputs into the Obsidian vault with frontmatter, tags and Fund/Investor backlinks. Use for `/fund vault-sync` or filing reviews in the vault. Writes `VAULT-SYNC-[date].md`.
- [fund-monitor-email](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-monitor-email/SKILL.md): Scans Gmail for GP and administrator emails with PDF attachments and saves them to the vault Inbox; needs a Gmail connector. Use for `/fund monitor-email`. Writes EMAIL-MONITOR-[date].md.
- [fund-multi-doc-analyze](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-multi-doc-analyze/SKILL.md): Cross-references related fund documents for provision conflicts, amendment lineage and MFN cascades. Use for `/fund multi-doc-analyze` or an LPA plus side letters. Writes MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-[date].md.
- [fund-smart-contract-sim](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-smart-contract-sim/SKILL.md): Simulates a distribution waterfall as code: tier-by-tier traces, edge cases, clawback checks, pseudocode. Use for `/fund smart-contract-sim`. Writes `WATERFALL-SIM-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-chat](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-chat/SKILL.md): Answers ad hoc questions over fund documents and prior `/fund` outputs with section and quote citations, naming the command that fills a gap. Use for `/fund chat`. Answers inline.
- [fund-amendment-draft](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-amendment-draft/SKILL.md): Drafts an LPA amendment: recitals, clauses, ratification, signatures, old-vs-new redline. Use for `/fund amendment-draft` or amending an LPA. Writes AMENDMENT-DRAFT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-esg-report](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-esg-report/SKILL.md): ESG report across SFDR (Art. 6/8/9, PAI), TCFD, EDCI, UN PRI and EU Taxonomy, scoring data gaps. Use for `/fund esg-report` or an SFDR/PAI disclosure. Writes ESG-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md.
- [fund-tax-review](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-tax-review/SKILL.md): Analyzes a K-1 or tax package for UBTI, ECI, 199A, 163(j), state apportionment, PFIC and capital account ties. Use for `/fund tax-review` or K-1 tax effects. Writes `TAX-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md`.
- [fund-board-memo](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-board-memo/SKILL.md): Board, LPAC or annual meeting memo: agenda, performance, conflicts, resolutions, Q&A prep. Use for `/fund board-memo <type>` or LPAC meeting materials. Writes BOARD-MEMO-[type]-[date].md.
- [fund-wire-verify](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-wire-verify/SKILL.md): Checks new wire instructions against history for bank or beneficiary changes, FATF risk and timing anomalies, with a verification checklist. Use for `/fund wire-verify` or new bank details.

## Agents

- [fund-terms](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-terms.md): Terms & Provisions, 20% of the LPA Safety Score
- [fund-risks](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-risks.md): Risk Assessment, 25% of the LPA Safety Score
- [fund-compliance](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-compliance.md): Regulatory Compliance, 20% of the LPA Safety Score
- [fund-obligations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-obligations.md): Obligations & Timeline, 15% of the LPA Safety Score
- [fund-recommendations](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/agents/fund-recommendations.md): Recommendations, 20% of the LPA Safety Score

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai): skills source, full sample corpus, Obsidian vault MCP server, web app
